title: Independent cross-check of one published row: FOKUS 76.5% agrees with a second provider to within one point
detail: The published snapshot prices FOKUS vs ex-6666 (1079193) at 76.5%% / 23.5%% from the Polymarket order-book midpoint taken at 2026-10-23T20:09:34Z. A second, independent surface read at 2026-10-24T06:33Z published FOKUS 1.23 / ex-6666 3.83 decimal; proportional margin removal gives 75.7%% / 24.3%% (overround 7.41%%). The two independent observations agree within 0.8 points. This corroborates one row only; it neither replaces the published market figure nor generalises to other rows, and a prediction market and an aggregated bookmaker display are different instruments.
